say:1:1320101002:0.text: Seems like somebody needs help over there. Let's go, Magister!
say:1:1320101002:0.source_cn: 那边好像有人在求救，主人我们去看看吧！
say:1:1320101002:0.male: Seems like somebody needs help over there. Let's go, Magister!
say:1:1320101002:0.female: Seems like somebody needs help over there. Let's go, Magister!

say:0:1320102001:0.text: That's odd. What's a bear doing sitting here?
say:0:1320102001:0.source_cn: 奇怪，这只熊怎么坐在这里？
say:0:1320102001:0.male: That's odd. What's a bear doing sitting here?
say:0:1320102001:0.female: That's odd. What's a bear doing sitting here?

say:1:1320102002:0.text: It looks like it doesn't know what to do...
say:1:1320102002:0.source_cn: 它看起来有点不知所措……
say:1:1320102002:0.male: It looks like it doesn't know what to do...
say:1:1320102002:0.female: It looks like it doesn't know what to do...

say:2:1320102003:0.text: Let's try to drive it away before it hurts someone.
say:2:1320102003:0.source_cn: 先把它赶跑吧，防止它伤人。
say:2:1320102003:0.male: Let's try to drive it away before it hurts someone.
say:2:1320102003:0.female: Let's try to drive it away before it hurts someone.

say:0:1320103001:0.text: Whoa, it just bolted away so fast! What a sprint!
say:0:1320103001:0.source_cn: 怎么一下就跑了？嚯！跑这么快！
say:0:1320103001:0.male: Whoa, it just bolted away so fast! What a sprint!
say:0:1320103001:0.female: Whoa, it just bolted away so fast! What a sprint!

say:1:1320103002:0.text: It doesn't seem to be aggressive at all. Isn't that strange?
say:1:1320103002:0.source_cn: 它好像一点儿攻击性都没有，真奇怪……
say:1:1320103002:0.male: It doesn't seem to be aggressive at all. Isn't that strange?
say:1:1320103002:0.female: It doesn't seem to be aggressive at all. Isn't that strange?

say:2:1320103003:0.text: Let's follow it and get a better look.
say:2:1320103003:0.male: Let's follow it and get a better look.
say:2:1320103003:0.female: Let's follow it and get a better look.

say:0:1320104001:0.text: This hornleaf bear... It seems odd somehow.
say:0:1320104001:0.source_cn: 这叶角熊……看着有些奇怪。
say:0:1320104001:0.male: This hornleaf bear... It seems odd somehow.
say:0:1320104001:0.female: This hornleaf bear... It seems odd somehow.

say:1:1320104002:0.text: It looks like a normal hornleaf bear, but something feels different about this one.
say:1:1320104002:0.source_cn: 看着像是正常的叶角熊，但感觉又有些区别。

say:2:1320104003:0.text: Strange indeed... Let's catch up with it.
say:2:1320104003:0.source_cn: 确实奇怪……我们追上去看看。
say:2:1320104003:0.male: Strange indeed... Let's catch up with it.
say:2:1320104003:0.female: Strange indeed... Let's catch up with it.

say:1:1320105002:0.text: Let's go and see what it drew.
say:1:1320105002:0.male: Let's go and see what it drew.
say:1:1320105002:0.female: Let's go and see what it drew.

say:2:1320106002:1.text: Is it... some kind of food? Doesn't really look like it.
say:2:1320106002:1.source_cn: 这是……一种食物吗？也不像啊。

say:4:1320106004:0.text: No, no... Look, it's shaking its head.
say:4:1320106004:0.source_cn: 不对不对，你看叶角熊都摇头了。

say:5:1320106005:1.text: Look from this angle, see? It's an arrow... pointing in that direction! Hmm... I seem to remember there being a hornleaf bear den over there...
say:5:1320106005:1.source_cn: 这个角度，看！我觉得——是个指向那边的箭头。唔，我记得...

say:7:1320106007:1.text: Okay, I got it. You want to find your way home! You must be lost!
say:7:1320106007:1.source_cn: 明白了，原来你想回家呀！你一定是迷路了。

say:8:1320106008:1.text: There's not much food around this time of year either, so you must be starving. Poor old hornleaf bear...
say:8:1320106008:1.source_cn: 这样的天气也没什么食物，你肯定挨饿了，可怜的叶角熊……

say:9:1320106009:1.text: Chippy didn't think it could be so smart, trying to communicate with us like that.
say:9:1320106009:1.source_cn: 没想到它这么聪明，在尝试用这种方式和我们交流。

say:10:1320106010:1.text: How do we get it back to its den, Magister?
say:10:1320106010:1.source_cn: 主人，我们该怎么把它送回熊窝呀？
say:10:1320106010:1.male: How do we get it back to its den, Magister?
say:10:1320106010:1.female: How do we get it back to its den, Magister?

choice_prompt:11:1320106010.text: How do we get it back to its den, Magister?
choice_prompt:11:1320106010.source_cn: 主人，我们该怎么把它送回熊窝呀？
choice_prompt:11:1320106010.male: How do we get it back to its den, Magister?
choice_prompt:11:1320106010.female: How do we get it back to its den, Magister?

say:12:1320106012:0.text: Magister, how about we pick some <style="stress">fresh crystalberries</style> to lure it back to the den?
say:12:1320106012:0.source_cn: 主人我们采点<style=stress>新鲜冰晶莓</...
say:12:1320106012:0.male: Magister, how about we pick some <style="stress">fresh crystalberries</style> to lure it back to the den?
say:12:1320106012:0.female: Magister, how about we pick some <style="stress">fresh crystalberries</style> to lure it back to the den?

choice:11:0:1.source_cn: 采点<style=stress>新鲜冰晶莓</style>引它过去

say:15:1320106011:0.text: Nice, so it can reunite with its friends!
say:15:1320106011:0.source_cn: 好哇！这样它就能和同伴们团聚了！
say:15:1320106011:0.male: Nice, so it can reunite with its friends!
say:15:1320106011:0.female: Nice, so it can reunite with its friends!

say:0:1320107001:0.text: Whoa, so many crystalberries! Chippy can't carry them all!
say:0:1320107001:0.source_cn: 喔！好多冰晶莓，捧不过来了！

say:1:1320107002:0.text: This should be enough to lure the hornleaf bear. Let's head back.
say:1:1320107002:0.source_cn: 这些引叶角熊足够了，回去吧。
say:1:1320107002:0.male: This should be enough to lure the hornleaf bear. Let's head back.
say:1:1320107002:0.female: This should be enough to lure the hornleaf bear. Let's head back.

say:0:1320108001:0.text: It's following the crystalberries! It's working!
say:0:1320108001:0.source_cn: 它跟着冰晶莓过来了！看起来有效！

say:0:1320109001:0.text: Huh?! Why'd another hornleaf bear attack its own kind?
say:0:1320109001:0.source_cn: 啊！为什么叶角熊的同类会攻击它？

say:1:1320109002:0.text: It got scared away by its companion!

say:0:1320110001:0.text: It's settled, then. Let's follow it for a better look.
say:0:1320110001:0.source_cn: 解决了，我们先追上去看看。
say:0:1320110001:0.male: It's settled, then. Let's follow it for a better look.
say:0:1320110001:0.female: It's settled, then. Let's follow it for a better look.

say:1:1320111001:0.text: Weird. Why's it ignoring the food?
say:1:1320111001:0.source_cn: 咦，怎么给它食物也不理睬了。

say:3:1320111002:0.text: It's drawing again. What's it trying to tell us this time?
say:3:1320111002:0.source_cn: 它又在涂涂画画了，到底想表达什么呢？

say:4:1320111003:0.text: It looks kinda like a word... But Chippy can't understand it...
say:4:1320111003:0.source_cn: 看起来有点像是字……可这根本看不懂啊。

say:5:1320111004:1.text: Has it actually learned the concept of words?!
say:5:1320111004:1.source_cn: 它居然都成长到可以领悟文字的程度了吗！

say:6:1320111005:1.text: I mean, it's totally unreadable... So it's still got some learning to do.
say:6:1320111005:1.source_cn: 虽然完全看不懂……还需要经过一段时间学习。

say:7:1320111006:1.text: I had no idea that any creatures besides familiars could reach this level of intelligence!
say:7:1320111006:1.source_cn: 没想到除了被创造出来的使魔外，还有生物能达到这个智力水平！

say:8:1320111007:1.text: I'm gonna pluck a few of its hairs and take them back to study.
say:8:1320111007:1.source_cn: 我要拔几根它的毛回去研究一下。

say:9:1320111008:1.text: What's it trying to tell us? The crystalberries aren't yummy enough?
say:9:1320111008:1.source_cn: 它想表达什么？觉得冰晶莓不够好吃？

say:11:1320111010:1.text: Maybe it's just not hungry? Maybe it just wants to play with us?
say:11:1320111010:1.source_cn: 难道是不饿？想要我们陪它玩？

say:15:1320111013:1.text: Wait... It looks like it's about to cry!
say:15:1320111013:1.source_cn: 等等——它看起来要急哭了！

say:16:1320111014:1.text: How's it make such vivid expressions? It's really something worth studying!
say:16:1320111014:1.source_cn: 它居然还能做出这么生动的表情！值得研究！

say:2:1320112002:0.text: Whoa, why's it still roaring at us?!

say:3:1320112003:0.text: Something's not quite right. Let's keep following it.
say:3:1320112003:0.source_cn: 感觉不太对，先跟上去看看。
say:3:1320112003:0.male: Something's not quite right. Let's keep following it.
say:3:1320112003:0.female: Something's not quite right. Let's keep following it.

say:1:1320115001:0.text: I thought I was gonna be a bear forever!
say:1:1320115001:0.source_cn: 差点以为，要做一辈子叶角熊了！

choice_prompt:2:1320115001.text: I thought I was gonna be a bear forever!
choice_prompt:2:1320115001.source_cn: 差点以为，要做一辈子叶角熊了！

say:4:1320115003:0.text: I remember he was dressed in blue, with round-rimmed glasses and blonde bowl-cut hair.
say:4:1320115003:0.source_cn: 我记得他穿着蓝衣服，带着圆框眼镜，金发，留着锅盖头……
say:4:1320115003:0.male: I remember he was dressed in blue, with round-rimmed glasses and blonde bowl-cut hair.
say:4:1320115003:0.female: I remember he was dressed in blue, with round-rimmed glasses and blonde bowl-cut hair.

say:5:1320115004:0.text: Oh! Chippy remembers him from the festival!
say:5:1320115004:0.source_cn: 这、这不就是祭典上的那个——

say:7:1320115006:1.text: Magic is a serious affair! The slightest carelessness could lead to disaster!
say:7:1320115006:1.source_cn: 魔法是一门严谨的艺术！稍有不慎后果不堪设想！

say:8:1320115007:0.text: I wanted to experience life as an animal, and he said he could help.
say:8:1320115007:0.source_cn: 我想体验一下动物的生活，他说能帮我。

say:9:1320115008:0.text: He said I would change back in a few hours, but I was stuck for days on end!
say:9:1320115008:0.source_cn: 本来说过几小时就会变回来的，谁知道我一连几天都没复原！

say:10:1320115009:0.text: Everyone I saw was scared of me, and there was no way for me to communicate...
say:10:1320115009:0.source_cn: 人们见到我就害怕，也根本没法交流……

say:11:1320115010:0.text: And of course I couldn't integrate with the other hornleaf bears.
say:11:1320115010:0.source_cn: 也没办法融入叶角熊群。

say:12:1320115011:0.text: I know, I know, geniuses are destined to be ostracized...
say:12:1320115011:0.source_cn: 我懂，被排挤是天才的宿命……

say:13:1320115012:0.text: Alright then, genius. It's time for you to rejoin human society.
say:13:1320115012:0.source_cn: 好啦，天才现在该入世啦。

choice:2:0:1.text: How did you turn into a bear?!
choice:2:0:1.male: How did you turn into a bear?!
choice:2:0:1.female: How did you turn into a bear?!

say:14:1320115013:0.text: I was thinking of my notes, but when I tried to write, nothing looked right! I couldn't express anything! So I had to think of a simpler way.
say:14:1320115013:0.source_cn: 我心里想着“笔记”，但是画出来，就变得什么都不像了，根...
say:14:1320115013:0.male: I was thinking of my notes, but when I tried to write, nothing looked right! I couldn't express anything! So I had to think of a simpler way.
say:14:1320115013:0.female: I was thinking of my notes, but when I tried to write, nothing looked right! I couldn't express anything! So I had to think of a simpler way.

say:15:1320115014:0.text: So as a hornleaf bear, your perceptions had changed...
say:15:1320115014:0.source_cn: 看来作为叶角熊，认知会被改变啊……

say:16:1320115015:0.text: It's not that I didn't want to—I just couldn't!
say:16:1320115015:0.source_cn: 不是我不想写，是写不出来！
say:16:1320115015:0.male: It's not that I didn't want to—I just couldn't!
say:16:1320115015:0.female: It's not that I didn't want to—I just couldn't!

say:17:1320115016:0.text: After I turned into a bear, my mind felt all muddled up.
say:17:1320115016:0.source_cn: 变成叶角熊之后，脑子浑浑噩噩的。
say:17:1320115016:0.male: After I turned into a bear, my mind felt all muddled up.
say:17:1320115016:0.female: After I turned into a bear, my mind felt all muddled up.

say:18:1320115017:0.text: I couldn't remember how to write words at all.
say:18:1320115017:0.male: I couldn't remember how to write words at all.
say:18:1320115017:0.female: I couldn't remember how to write words at all.

say:19:1320115018:0.text: I see, so memory was affected as well.
say:19:1320115018:0.source_cn: 唔，看来记忆会受到影响啊。

choice:2:2:3.text: Why didn't you just write words?
choice:2:2:3.male: Why didn't you just write words?
choice:2:2:3.female: Why didn't you just write words?

say:20:1320115019:0.text: Ah! I'd like to observe the hornleaf bear one last time!
say:20:1320115019:0.source_cn: 啊！我、我还想再观察一下叶角熊。
say:20:1320115019:0.male: Ah! I'd like to observe the hornleaf bear one last time!
say:20:1320115019:0.female: Ah! I'd like to observe the hornleaf bear one last time!

say:21:1320115020:0.text: So you actually miss living life as a bear?!
say:21:1320115020:0.source_cn: 你这是还怀念叶角熊的生活吗！

say:22:1320115021:0.text: I feel like there's a question I'm on the brink of answering, and I have a hunch that the answer is right under my nose!
say:22:1320115021:0.source_cn: 我感觉有个问题就要想通了，我预感答案就在我的眼前了！

say:23:1320115022:0.text: I'll regret it for a lifetime if I abandon this moment of inspiration.
say:23:1320115022:0.source_cn: 放弃这个灵感，我一定会后悔终生的。

say:24:1320115023:0.text: Please, just let me observe from a distance!
say:24:1320115023:0.source_cn: 拜托了，让我远远地看看就好！

choice:2:3:4.text: We'll bring you back to town.
choice:2:3:4.male: We'll bring you back to town.
choice:2:3:4.female: We'll bring you back to town.

narration:0:1320116001:1.text: The philosopher watches the hornleaf bear for quite a long time.

say:2:1320116002:0.text: I'm bored! How long has it been?

say:4:1320116004:1.text: Sheesh, you scared me half to death!

say:6:1320116006:1.text: Hey, why'd you take off on your own?
say:6:1320116006:1.source_cn: 哎！你怎么自顾自地就走了？

say:8:1320116008:0.source_cn: 原来是这样吗……原来如此，原来如此！

say:9:1320116009:1.text: You're muttering to yourself, and it's got us worried. Are you alright?
say:9:1320116009:1.source_cn: 你这样自言自语，让人很担心你的精神状态啊……

say:10:1320116010:1.text: Perhaps being transformed for so long has affected your mental capacities?
say:10:1320116010:1.source_cn: 中了太久变形咒，还会影响智力吗？

say:1:1320117001:0.text: We're back at the inn. Get some rest—and no more funny magic from sketchy mages!
say:1:1320117001:0.source_cn: 到旅馆了，好好休息吧，别再尝试来路不明的魔法了。

say:2:1320117002:0.text: Dura above, thank you all! You're truly voices of reason!
say:2:1320117002:0.source_cn: 艾雅在上，谢谢你们！你们一定是真理的代言人。

say:5:1320117004:2.text: Great Mage, I'd like to ask you something.
say:5:1320117004:2.source_cn: 大魔法师，我向您请教个问题。
say:5:1320117004:2.male: Great Mage, I'd like to ask you something.
say:5:1320117004:2.female: Great Mage, I'd like to ask you something.

say:6:1320117005:0.text: If the body changes, does the spirit change in tandem?
say:6:1320117005:0.source_cn: 身体不同，灵魂会不会跟着改变？
say:6:1320117005:0.male: If the body changes, does the spirit change in tandem?
say:6:1320117005:0.female: If the body changes, does the spirit change in tandem?

choice_prompt:7:1320117005.text: If the body changes, does the spirit change in tandem?
choice_prompt:7:1320117005.source_cn: 身体不同，灵魂会不会跟着改变？
choice_prompt:7:1320117005.male: If the body changes, does the spirit change in tandem?
choice_prompt:7:1320117005.female: If the body changes, does the spirit change in tandem?

say:8:1320117006:1.text: I wouldn't have learned this if it weren't for this experience.
say:8:1320117006:1.source_cn: 要不是这次经历，我也想不明白这个问题。
say:8:1320117006:1.male: I wouldn't have learned this if it weren't for this experience.
say:8:1320117006:1.female: I wouldn't have learned this if it weren't for this experience.

say:9:1320117007:1.text: Thanks be to Dura! I'm lucky to have found you, and found my answer as well.
say:9:1320117007:1.source_cn: 感谢艾雅！幸好我遇到了您，也找到了答案。
say:9:1320117007:1.male: Thanks be to Dura! I'm lucky to have found you, and found my answer as well.
say:9:1320117007:1.female: Thanks be to Dura! I'm lucky to have found you, and found my answer as well.

say:10:1320117008:1.text: Even if I were to turn into a hornleaf bear, I'd still be myself.
say:10:1320117008:1.source_cn: 哪怕我变成了叶角熊，但是我还是我。
say:10:1320117008:1.male: Even if I were to turn into a hornleaf bear, I'd still be myself.
say:10:1320117008:1.female: Even if I were to turn into a hornleaf bear, I'd still be myself.

say:11:1320117009:1.text: The body may change, but I will remain.
say:11:1320117009:1.source_cn: 身体的变化，并不会影响我的存在。
say:11:1320117009:1.male: The body may change, but I will remain.
say:11:1320117009:1.female: The body may change, but I will remain.

say:12:1320117010:1.text: I feel like I'm one step closer to the truth!
say:12:1320117010:1.source_cn: 我觉得我离真理又近了一步！
say:12:1320117010:1.male: I feel like I'm one step closer to the truth!
say:12:1320117010:1.female: I feel like I'm one step closer to the truth!

choice:4:0:1.text: It was no trouble at all.
choice:4:0:1.male: It was no trouble at all.
choice:4:0:1.female: It was no trouble at all.

choice:4:1:2.text: So what did you figure out?
choice:4:1:2.male: So what did you figure out?
choice:4:1:2.female: So what did you figure out?

say:1:1320113001:0.text: Hmm... These are some kind of philosophical writings... Chippy can't really understand it.
say:1:1320113001:0.source_cn: 唔……这是一些哲学笔记，好绕啊！

say:2:1320113002:1.text: It's as bad as what the hornleaf bear wrote. Can't make heads or tails of it...
say:2:1320113002:1.source_cn: 怎么和叶角熊写的有得一拼，都不像人话……

say:4:1320113003:1.text: Although the last few sentences... Seems like the writer is exploring whether or not he's still himself after transforming his body.
say:4:1320113003:1.source_cn: 看最后几句……好像作者是在探究：换个身体后，还是不是自己。

choice_prompt:5:1320113003.text: Although the last few sentences... Seems like the writer is exploring whether or not he's still himself after transforming his body.
choice_prompt:5:1320113003.source_cn: 看最后几句……好像作者是在探究：换个身体后，还是不是自己。

say:8:1320113006:0.text: No need to beat around the bush...

say:10:1320113010:1.text: That hornleaf bear... It can't be... It can't be!
say:10:1320113010:1.source_cn: 这叶角熊……该不会是——该不会是！
say:10:1320113010:1.male: That hornleaf bear... It can't be... It can't be!
say:10:1320113010:1.female: That hornleaf bear... It can't be... It can't be!

choice_prompt:11:1320113010.text: That hornleaf bear... It can't be... It can't be!
choice_prompt:11:1320113010.source_cn: 这叶角熊……该不会是——该不会是！
choice_prompt:11:1320113010.male: That hornleaf bear... It can't be... It can't be!
choice_prompt:11:1320113010.female: That hornleaf bear... It can't be... It can't be!

say:12:1320113011:1.text: It really is a transformed human!
say:12:1320113011:1.male: It really is a transformed human!
say:12:1320113011:1.female: It really is a transformed human!

say:13:1320113012:1.text: Hey bear! Were you a human?

say:16:1320113015:1.text: How'd you get turned into a bear?!

narration:17:1320113016:0.text: The hornleaf bear is actually a person?! You prepare a spell to turn it back.
narration:17:1320113016:0.source_cn: 这只叶角熊居然是个人？！这可真是奇怪……你们准备施法将...

narration:23:13020132:0.text: You use magic to try to undo the transformation on the hornleaf bear, and indeed, you turn him back into a human.
narration:23:13020132:0.source_cn: 你用魔法试着解除叶角熊身上的变形术，果然将他变回了人类。

choice:5:0:1.text: Guys, I've got a crazy idea.
